item.title: About
item.description:
I’m Nitesh Kumar, a Python Backend Developer at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) in Kolkata, where I build scalable REST APIs and backend services.

What I do

  • Design and ship REST APIs with FastAPI — clean routing, validation, and auth
  • Work with Firestore, SQL databases, and Redis for persistence and caching
  • Deploy and operate services on AWS with Docker-based workflows
  • Write tested, maintainable code — pytest, code reviews, CI-friendly habits

Experience

  • Python Backend Developer, TCS — Apr 2025 → Present (Kolkata)
  • Frontend Developer Intern, HSR Hi-Tech — Jan → Jun 2024
  • AWS Intern, LinuxWorld Informatics — Jul → Sep 2023
  • React Developer, Whizzo — Jan → Mar 2023

Education & credentials

  • B.Tech, Haldia Institute of Technology — CGPA 8.50
  • Certifications: TCS Python Advanced, Trainocate AWS, Microsoft Agentic AI
  • Languages: Hindi, English, Bengali
